svg.text: Current HW firmware · States, transitions and function operations · 2026-10-13
Power-on: all joints are assumed to be physically OPEN (the position origin for this boot)
App_Init() → Motor_InitAll() / Comms_Init(): prepare safe outputs, feedback and communication, then wait for the handshake.
Normal stop: return first, then disable outputs
Driver disabled; wait for a valid Hello
Enter READY after OPEN is continuously settled
PID holds initial pose; wait for start permission
Comms_GetNextIntent(): dequeue only in this state
Queue empty: retain targets and PID hold
No next-intent dequeue; communication and safety stay active
Cancel old action, clear queue, invalidate old command epoch
Outputs disabled; PID reset; no intent dequeue
Immediately inhibit outputs, reset PID, clear queue
Queue still nonempty → dequeue next intent in the same App_Task() cycle
STOP: cancel action and queue, then return to OPEN
STOP in INIT_MODULES: no motion yet; go directly to STOPPED
Safety fault in any state / ESTOP
Stop immediately; bypass STOPPING; do not return
Recovery conditions unmet: RECOVERY_DENIED; remain in FAULT
RESTART + successful Motor_RecoverFromFault(): STOPPED / FAULT → INIT_HANDSHAKE
Keep the origin from this boot → handshake and initialize again → READY still requires a new ALLOW_START
• Valid, fresh feedback for all enabled motors
• Both hold continuously for 250 ms (about 2° tolerance)
• Either error exceeds tolerance: restart settling timer
• Compare new targets with previously accepted targets
• Check drift in unchanged joints; do not skip validation
• Same criteria for initialization and STOP return
• Timeout means FAULT, not successful completion
Communication and safety in all states
• Module wait for valid feedback > 10 s → FAULT
• No valid message for 500 ms, or 1 s since last probe
• No valid message for 2 s, or no matching PONG
within 2 s after PING → LINK fault (also in work / return)
• Restoring communication with Hello does not resume motion
• Faults: link loss, invalid feedback, stall, force limit,
driver / PID error, control delay, action timeout
• Inhibit outputs first; log cause and motors asynchronously
• STOP / RESTART / start permission bypass intent_queue
• Intent capacity 8: drop new intents when full; report
QUEUE_FULL; reject RESTART / DENY_START during work
• Loops continue after stop; disabled motors do not drive
Based on current HW source; function names match the implementation. SIM v2 is separate. OPEN at power-on is an assumption, not automatic homing.
ActionStarted = CommsSession_ActionStarted(). Calibration follows the first handshake; RESTART does not call App_Init() or reset encoders. Values are current software defaults.
